regions.merged_text: Eugene McNulty - 48 (of Huntington) Hopeless with "Spacia" - slow paralysis - Doctoring for about 9 yrs. - Mayo's, etc. - goes to holy Communion weekly. Was pleased at being urged to promote frequent Communion. - Enrolls perpetually - self and PP. Souls 10.00

regions.merged_text: Randall Gerow - 2 - brought To-day from 14628 Rabeon, Redford, Michigan; bright lively child, However, he has a peculiarly threatening-conditioned neck - uncanny groth over juggler & al- most frightening voice. The methodest Father drove down in the rain and waits out in car till called in. The mother a one time Catholic not to sacraments for years . They enroll child and both kneel for blessing of Cross relic. . quite hopefully smiling docilly promising.

regions.merged_text: Feast of St. James 48 Anniv. - Minor Orders To-day about 50 or 60 here from N. Man. Ind.with Sunday School - Young Methodist Minister also who had accompanied them came in during talk in Chapel and seemed much interested - came into Of- fice afterwards with wife and several others. Deo Gr.

regions.merged_text: Same Mrs. Ehinger here To-day. Tells us, now in perfect health. The doctors had told her in July she could not live over a month .... Now astonished at her smiling condition. Glory be to God! She en- rolls the Holy Souls specially in Thanksgiving. Deo Grat! 5.00
